comment: These judgments are exactly the current v7 inputs not already covered atom-by-atom by the v10 statement ledger: finite-equality representation instances, source-market nonemptiness inputs, and the exact per-period available-set nonemptiness condition. The conditional mean and variance premises in Appendix C are source-located and v10-covered. For k-sampling, only profile, feasible positive k, and representation instances are inputs; the top set, its cardinality and cross-cutoff dominance, nonemptiness, and the uniform policy are all derived Lean conclusions.

paper_facing_expected_regret.h_nonempty.reason: The premise is exactly the source's per-period market nonemptiness condition and supplies no regret bound or selected-quality conclusion.
paper_facing_expected_regret.h_nonempty.source_evidence: At each timestep a consumer chooses a product v(t) from the currently available set M(t), and Equation 4 takes max over that set; this source model requires M(t) to be nonempty.
paper_facing_expected_regret.h_nonempty.source_location: ICWSM 19(1), Section 2.2 and Equation 4; cited publication:288-313 and 354-369
paper_facing_expected_regret.h_nonempty.validator: Codex MBJG25 source-record v7 semantic auditor 2026-07-18

paper_facing_expected_regret.instance_2.lean_derivation: The same row already supplies a Fintype instance for this carrier; finite enumeration constructs exact equality decisions, so the instance is proved from representation primitives.
paper_facing_expected_regret.instance_2.reason: Decidable equality is finite-representation infrastructure. It states no posterior, fairness, regret, argmax, bias, variance, or decomposition conclusion.
paper_facing_expected_regret.instance_2.source_evidence: The source uses finite product or finite quality classes; exact equality is only needed to form the corresponding finite filters and maxima.
paper_facing_expected_regret.instance_2.source_location: ICWSM 19(1), Sections 2.1-2.3 and 4.1; cited publication:203-390 and 680-708
paper_facing_expected_regret.instance_2.validator: Codex MBJG25 source-record v7 semantic auditor 2026-07-18

paper_facing_expected_regret.instance_3.reason: This typeclass records only existence of a product in the source market and does not assume the regret formula or an optimal product identity.
paper_facing_expected_regret.instance_3.source_evidence: The source has a universe of products V and at every market period a consumer chooses one currently available product, so the modeled product carrier is nonempty.
